responsibility: Portable document numbering: format, reset and scope values, allocator port and one refusal.
non_responsibilities: Any allocator implementation: counter store, transaction, locks, fencing, deadlock retry and unique constraints.
Business numbering policy: which documents are numbered, what an invoice or stock number is, and repair.
A fiscal calendar: a fiscal-period key is a posting period the host declared; the package only renders it.
Site and organization authority: the record scope a counter is keyed by is resolved and enforced by the host.
Container registration: values, port and refusal are constructed directly; the host binds its adapter.
Real-database evidence, which the host proves on the engines it supports.

capabilities.title: Number format declaration and rendering
capabilities.description: A validated declaration with a closed grammar that names its counter and renders a value.

capabilities.title: Reset period vocabulary and period keys
capabilities.description: The calendar boundary a run restarts at, and an instant's period key in the declared zone.

capabilities.title: Tenancy scope vocabulary and scope keys
capabilities.description: The tenancy boundary a run is unique within, and the closed scope-key grammar.

capabilities.title: Allocator port and its one refusal
capabilities.description: The gapless-on-commit allocator port and its one refusal; the package ships no implementation.
